full_text: Him Parbat Hydropower Limited is going to issue its 16,90,000.00 units IPO shares to the project affected local residents of Dolakha District, Bigu VDC, Ward No. 05 - 08, Kalinchowk VDC Ward No. 02-04 and rest of both VDCs all Wards starting from 11th - 25th Kartik, 2083
Him Parbat Hydropower Limited is going to issue its 4,22,500.00 units of IPO shares to the Nepalese citizens working abroad starting from 11th - 16th Kartik, 2083
